sectors.trend: Strong momentum: OpenAI GPT-6 launch, Arm $2B revenue target (+17%), Fastly AI firewall (+14%), Meta Muse AI agent spurring Korean chip stocks, Intel/Arm surge. Chinese AI firms hit by regulatory probe but chip IPOs continue.
sectors.implications: AI capex cycle accelerating globally; US firms benefit from China regulatory overhang. Arm's $2B goal signals structural shift in semiconductor demand. Fastly/Cloudflare/Datadog rally validates AI security infrastructure thesis.

sectors.trend: Oil seesaws on Iran talks and Saudi pipeline fix hopes. Diesel shortage from Iran/Ukraine wars to last into 2027. Palm oil at 7-week low on ample reserves. Coking coal supply squeeze lingering into 2027.
sectors.implications: Structural diesel tightness supports energy equities long-term despite near-term price volatility. Saudi pipeline fix could cap upside. Diversify energy exposure beyond crude.

sectors.trend: Bonds and Treasury futures rise on oil slide. Gold edges lower on Fedspeak but Chinese gold imports hit record. Silver at highs. Copper retreats from near-record on Fed outlook. Credit megafunds dominance growing.
sectors.implications: Rate cut expectations firming. Gold/silver bid from central bank buying (China) provides floor. Credit megafund concentration is a systemic risk factor.

sectors.trend: Boeing 737 Max delays; DoorDash $131M NYC settlement; GM enters missile manufacturing; XPeng robotaxi price war; TJX pullback buying; Hormel underperforming consumer defensives.
sectors.implications: Consumer discretionary mixed. Industrial diversification (GM missiles) signals defense-civilian convergence. Labor cost pressures on gig economy.

sectors.trend: Paramount-Warner merger settles with states but opposition continues. Trump bans three media orgs; CNN/Politico/MS NOW plan lawsuits. Airtel Money targets $8-9B London IPO.
sectors.implications: Regulatory and political risk elevated for media. Consolidation trend continues despite pushback. Emerging market fintech IPOs signal capital formation momentum.

market_outlook.short_term: Risk-on bias continues with tech leading. Oil volatility from Iran talks is the primary swing factor. Bond rally supports equities. Watch for US-China summit outcome (Xi unlikely to bring CEOs = limited trade deal). Crypto momentum intact. 1-3 month: constructive but choppy on geopolitics.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex supercycle remains the dominant structural theme. Diesel/coal tightness into 2027 supports energy. China regulatory overhang caps local AI but global winners benefit. Rate cuts likely through 2027. Political risk (midterms, media bans) adds noise. 6-12 month: selective equity outperformance in AI, energy, and precious metals.
